page.overview:
Who is Seed Collector?

The Seed Collector is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"It's all about teamwork. To gather food for the grasshoppers, every ant has a special job to do. Seed collectors like this one clamber up stalks, pick the seeds, and drop them to seed carriers at ground level. Look out below!"
